context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features tested and working. Backend APIs use Emergent LLM Key for NPC AI (GPT-5.2). Game is canvas-based with React overlay components. Tab opens menu with Skills/Equipment/Keybinds tabs. Battle mode triggered by walking to right edge of village map (x:27-29, y:5-8). Skills panel shows 7 skills with max 5 equippable. Equipment has 3 slots: weapon (wooden_sword/bronze_blade), armor (cloth_tunic/leather_armor), accessory (none/swift_boots/mana_charm).
